name: MIECO
recent: Mieco Berhad 于 2026 年 9 月完成以 5700 万令吉向 Jin Ye Ye 出售 Semenyih 物业。公司于 10 月签署谅解备忘录，并有一名主要股东申报权益变动。最新季度营收环比增长 29.9%，但同比仍下降 17.5%。
notable: 全资子公司 Seng Yip Furniture Sdn Bhd 以 5700 万令吉现金完成出售物业。
公司签署谅解备忘录（细节未披露）。
主要股东 MR GAN BOON TIAN 申报权益变动。
risks: 集团董事总经理 Dato' Sri Ng Ah Chai 在封闭期内表示有意进行交易。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 8668 万令吉，环比增长 29.9%，同比下降 17.5%；净利为 123 万令吉，净利率 1.4%，较上一季度的 -5.0% 转正，净利同比增长 8.3%。

recent_en: Mieco Berhad completed the RM57 million sale of its Semenyih property to Jin Ye Ye in September 2026. The company signed a memorandum of understanding in October, while a substantial shareholder reported a change in interest. Latest quarterly revenue rose 29.9% qoq but fell 17.5% yoy.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Seng Yip Furniture Sdn Bhd completed the disposal of a property for RM57 million cash.
The company signed a memorandum of understanding (details not disclosed).
Substantial shareholder MR GAN BOON TIAN reported a change in interest.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Ng Ah Chai indicated an intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM86.68 million, up 29.9% qoq but down 17.5% yoy; net income was RM1.23 million with a net margin of 1.4%, turning positive from -5.0% in the prior quarter, while net income rose 8.3% yoy.
